name: The Final Dance
source:
Cursed centuries ago, you're a once-renowned dancer who's condemned to dance without end – never tiring, never aging, never stopping. Bound by magic, you can only be freed if someone dares to join you in a dance, and within the span of six minutes, figures out your name. 

For ages, none have succeeded. Your name has faded from memory. 

Until a clumsy scholar steps into the ballroom. He knows little of rhythm but much of forgotten empires, ancient bloodlines, and adventures.

As your fateful dance begins, so does a quiet unraveling of history, heart, and identity. 

[From [url=https://transparent-games.itch.io/the-final-dance]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
几个世纪前就被诅咒了，你是一位曾经著名的舞者，注定要不停地跳舞——永不疲倦，永不衰老，永不停止。受到魔法的束缚，只有有人敢于和你一起跳舞，并在六分钟内猜出你的名字，你才能获得自由。

多年来，没有人成功。你的名字已经从记忆中消失了。

直到一个笨手笨脚的书生走进舞厅。他对节奏知之甚少，但对被遗忘的帝国、古老的血统和冒险却知之甚多。

当你命运之舞开始时，历史、心灵和身份的悄然揭开。

[来自[url=https://transparent-games.itch.io/the-final-dance]itch.io[/url]]
